scope: Test-only analytic 3D sphere face apertures and independent conormal line integrals passed through the actual reduced-pressure HLLC-backed geometric face operator and shared-face assembly. This is not numerical interface reconstruction, PR EOS/flash validation, swept surface-energy transport, or full solver acceptance.

negativeControls.wrongPressureJump: For pressureFactor=1.01, cell p and face Δp both rise 1%, keeping reduced HLLC pressure balanced and mass flux zero; physical pressure-aperture force no longer balances unchanged true surface traction.
negativeControls.fixedFaceJumpPerturbedCellPressure: Separate CPU and CUDA face cases hold face Δp fixed and perturb one cell p by 1 Pa; nonzero HLLC contact speed and mass flux asserted.

unitChecks: bulk-only HLLC energy plus separate supplied surface advection
moving asymmetric face same-velocity traction work
